name: Tourism
overview: Scripture reveals that the journey of life, including times of travel and rest, is under the sovereign guidance of the Lord, who orders and directs the steps of His people (Psalms 37:23; Proverbs 16:9). Believers are encouraged to wait patiently on the Lord and find rest amid their comings and goings, as Jesus exemplified by inviting His disciples to withdraw and rest (Psalms 40:1; Mark 6:31). Though the world changes, God's word remains unchanging and trustworthy throughout all seasons of life and movement (Matthew 24:35).
